title: Deploy test gate blocked two deploys on test-only defects: 6/10-6/11 stale audit-driver assertion (~11 h), 7/10 CI-branch-dependent sync test (~18 min)
tier_reason: test-only defects (the production code was correct); the gate failed closed and delayed two deploys; no production effect evidenced

contract.text: The deploy test gate fails a deploy only for a genuine defect: tests track the code they exercise and do not depend on the CI checkout's branch.
contract.source: 1ac0b0c (deploys gated on the test suite); df01882 body; 6919e19 body

mechanism.text: 049e851 made render_profile_command always emit --game-probability-mode without updating tests/test_audit_driver.py; the first gated deploy after it (run 27321348039, head 6471f40) failed on that test

the interrupted-sync round-trip test built its manifest through the real sync_to_r2, whose provenance stamp reads the checkout's branch; on the deploy workflow that is 'deploy', so sync_from_r2's main-branch refusal fired and run 29114359533 (head 2a75db2) failed

verified_recovered.how: next deploy run 27354604212 (head df01882) concluded success
run 29114882915 passed the gate and installed 6919e19 (canary passed)

watchdog.trigger: test-only defects (pre-ship); the gate itself is the control, not a W4 rank-2 boundary
